old_review.summary: Riley's review: the PAPER / SIMULATED cycle ended at $995.82 from $1,000, with precise P&L of -$4.18142465, approximately -0.4181%. Research quality is unassessable without proposal rationale and supporting analysis. Forecasting shows two positive AMZN estimates versus a -4.0763% hypothetical matched-window return, subject to unverified horizon and return-definition alignment. Selection and sizing are unassessable without the replacement decision and allocations. Execution attribution is unassessable without fills and costs. The original morning cash decision was supported by missing proposals and quotes; the later replacement was explicitly authorized once. One shared ticker outcome does not support changing confidence thresholds, catalyst weights or allocation policy. A four-week review-context hypothesis is the only proposed learning.
